purpose: Accept or reject one rectangular-prism model against its contract using independent read-only measurements, persistence records, and sufficient standard views.
trigger: A matching geometry, build, and execution chain identifies one rectangular-prism native model and exact acceptance criteria.

inputs.name: contract_chain
inputs.description: Hash-consistent upstream identities and expected primitive geometry.

inputs.name: acceptance_criteria
inputs.type: single-body bounds, volume, topology, name, tolerances, and view plan
inputs.description: The criteria derived from the accepted geometry contract.

preconditions: Geometry, build, execution, model, and report identities refer to the same parameter set and exact artifact chain.
The runtime report passes structural validation before its declarations are interpreted.
A read-only V21 validation .scscript and overview, top, front, and right view plan are available.
No validation action modifies or saves geometry.

outputs.name: acceptance_contract
outputs.description: Body, bounds, volume, topology, name, persistence, visual, export, evidence, and overall states.

outputs.name: validation_runtime_report
outputs.description: Measurements from the exact currently open model, kept separate from persistence and visual evidence.

outputs.name: visual_evidence
outputs.type: view records and screenshots or not_tested
outputs.description: Each view records orientation, selection state, expected feature, observed agreement, occlusion, path, and digest.

postconditions: The model has exactly one body with the required name, six faces, twelve edges, accepted bounds, and accepted volume.
The validation script performs no geometry creation, rename, named-selection creation, save, or export.
Native save, native reopen, read-only measurements, visual agreement, and requested export are reported independently.
Overview, top, front, and right views expose the three axis extents or record any unresolved occlusion.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer generates the read-only package; measurement execution and visual review require an authorized SpaceClaim 2022 R1/API V21 session.
implementation.notes: The generator emits the formal read-only .scscript; application measurements and view review remain separate runtime evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Require exactly one body and match name, bounds, volume, face count, and edge count; any extra body or mismatch fails acceptance.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Re-enumerate all bodies when the native model is opened or reopened before applying measurements.

failure_modes.condition: Upstream contracts, script, report, or model do not belong to the same artifact chain.
failure_modes.detection: Compare paths, parameters, and SHA-256 identities before measurement.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not combine or accept the evidence.

failure_modes.condition: Body count, name, bounds, volume, faces, or edges differ from the contract.
failure_modes.detection: Run the exact read-only validation package and compare within declared tolerances.
failure_modes.safe_state: Mark geometry acceptance failed and return to the responsible upstream stage.

failure_modes.condition: Forward and reopened model evidence differ or reopen was not completed.
failure_modes.detection: Compare independent forward and reopen identities and measurements.
failure_modes.safe_state: Keep native persistence failed or not_tested; do not infer it from file existence.

failure_modes.condition: Required geometry cannot be seen in the planned views.
failure_modes.detection: Record view, selection state, expected feature, and occluded item.
failure_modes.safe_state: Keep visual agreement unresolved rather than assuming conformity.

recovery.action: Restore a consistent exact-run artifact chain before any acceptance comparison.
Return to the earliest incorrect geometry or script stage, repair it, and create a new clean run.
Repeat save and reopen only from a passed clean run and retain separate forward and reopen evidence.
Change to a standard or focused view without modifying geometry and record the new view state.

validation.method: Generate, parse, package, and audit the validation .scscript with creation, rename, and save operations forbidden.
validation.expected: The formal validation artifact passes host checks and contains only read-only model enumeration and measurements.

validation.method: Run the read-only package against the exact native model and compare bounds, volume, name, faces, and edges.
validation.expected: Every required property matches within tolerance.

validation.method: Review overview, top, front, and right views with selection state and occlusion recorded.
validation.expected: The visible rectangular solid agrees with the accepted contract in all exposed directions.

evidence_level.notes: Case 001 completed read-only V21 measurement after native reopen plus overview/top/front/right review. These are case-instance results; template-level runtime layers remain not_tested until independent reuse evaluation.
